assumptions: "Orders" means distinct orders containing at least one item from the seller, counted via order_items.

2018 means purchase dates from 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31; the analysis window only covers January to August 2018, but the question asks for the calendar year 2018 and totals use all data in the requested period.
No minimum-order eligibility filter was applied because the question asks for the top sellers by order count, not a ranking with an eligibility threshold.

caveats: The analysis window only covers January through October 17, 2018, so the 2018 totals are incomplete; September and October are partial months (16 and 4 orders respectively).
Orders are counted as distinct orders containing at least one item from the seller, via order_items.

evidence.sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM analytics.order_items WHERE purchase_date >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND purchase_date < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY orders_count DESC, seller_id LIMIT 5
